name: Watashi ga Kyoushi ni Stalker Sareru Riyuu ga Mattaku Wakaranai Ken ni Tsuite.
original_name: 私が教師にストーカーされる理由が全く判らない件について。
source:
Sakura Tamiya is an ordinary high school student. The one thing that sets her apart from others is that she's being stalked by her homeroom teacher, Shuuichi Kanamori.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/10241]Freem![/url]]
